summary: Tested new Bill Edit feature (PUT /api/bills/{id}) end-to-end: backend pytest (6/6 passing) + frontend Playwright flow. Edit modal opens with 'EDIT BILL — P00004', bill-type toggles disabled, line 0 prefilled 194.9/4240 (rate derived from amount), total ₹7,97,844.00 matches list, save button 'Update Bill (Ctrl+S)'. Save with remark1='EDIT TEST' and payment_received=1000 updates bill, navigates to /bills/<id>, syncs rokad (1 entry type kharch, amount 1000, cash_account_name 'CASH IN HAND'). 'Edit Bill' button on BillView navigates to /bills?type=purchase&edit=<id> and reopens modal correctly. Revert restores payment_received=0 and removes rokad entry (back to 17). PUT nonexistent → 404; bill_type/bill_no cannot be changed via PUT. 'Naya Bill' after edit opens a clean empty form with proper title ('SALE / BILL ENTRY (नया बिल)'), enabled type toggles, 'Save Bill (Ctrl+S)' button. Parties/Rokad/Dashboard regression pages load fine. Final DB state verified: 4 bills unchanged, 17 rokad.

issues: Hydration console warning: <span> rendered as child of <option> (tooling-injected span with style display:contents inside <option>) — not a functional bug but pollutes console in dev; harmless in production build.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /bills/{bid}: existing['bill_type'] and existing['bill_no'] are preserved — correct. Immutability test passed (sending bill_type='sale' kept 'purchase').
_sync_bill_payment_rokad deletes & recreates rokad entries by ref_bill_id — idempotent, verified via revert flow.
BillIn is strict pydantic; frontend NayaBill.save() correctly strips id/bill_no/balance/created_at from payload. Good.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use existing P00004 and revert all mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_bill_edit.py covers bill edit + rokad sync + 404 + immutability + final-state assertions. Reusable regression. DB expected to always have 4 bills, 17 rokad, P00004 total 797844 with payment_received 0.
